key_insight: Spiking neural networks could complement transformer-based AI through event-driven computation, local learning, and temporal information coding.
engineering_relevance: Neuromorphic AI may support energy-constrained engineering applications, though the abstract establishes no specific solid-mechanics use case.
method: Explain transformer text generation using ChatGPT as an example.
Compare spike-based coding, local learning, and network design with conventional AI.
Review the Neural Engineering Framework and neuromorphic hardware, including Loihi 2.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a conceptual and mathematical monograph, citing energy contrasts but reporting no controlled benchmarks or solid-mechanics validation.
watch_item: Application-level energy savings and accuracy require validation; the brain's cited 20-watt power consumption is not directly comparable to aggregate model energy use.
paper_title: AI at a Turning Point: From ChatGPT through Neural Networks to Neuromorphic AI
